statusHistory.note: STEFAN byline. Sourced from near-sources-war-room's 2026-09-07 NYC seeding pass (trust: auto, corroborated by Yelp — 106+ reviews at seeding time, now higher — GayCities, thegaypassport, Travel Gay, and Astoria Post's original 2022 opening coverage). Google Maps confirms open and operating, 4.9 stars across 1,377 reviews, wheelchair accessible. This is Near's first Queens pin and first NYC nightlife-sound pin. Research floor: near-deep-researcher reconciled opening history (May 16, 2022, in the former Viva Viva space, owner Pedro Alvarado) against current-day coverage; Reddit (r/asktransgender, r/lgbt, r/Astoria) surfaces it repeatedly as a recommended safe queer space in Queens; Google/Yelp reviews (huge recent sample) consistently praise the drag brunch and the welcoming door policy, with occasional notes that weekend nights get loud and packed — noted here rather than smoothed over. Five preferred-sources context check: GayCities, Travel Gay, thegaypassport, Astoria Post, See The Queens.
Codex (GPT-6): corrected zh-CN mixed-script wording; verified Google Maps listing identity, address and existing pin. Coordinates unchanged. Language correction, not a full factual refresh.
